Dr.Ruchi Jain PT is a Physiotherapist working as a 'Neurodevelopmental therapist', 'Child Psychologist' and 'Female fitness mentor' since last 20 years.
Clinic:  Jyoti physiotherapy clinic Guna 
My family physio , rehabilitation and Child development centre Chunabhatti Bhopal MP .

She has work and training experience from NIMHANS and HOSMAT, Bangalore, India and NRG, MIA and RCH, Australia.
'WOW -WOMEN ONLINE WORKOUT' is an online fitness and guidance initiative by 'JYOTI PHYSIOTHERAPY CLINIC' under Dr.Ruchi’s supervision. She is a lifestyle coach, diet consultant , family and parental counsellor and motivational speaker. 

Post your queries on- 
ruchijainphysio@gmail.com 

Visit and follow this channel for Women's fitness and Child health, virtual autism and weight loss videos and guidance.
